description: Checks whether Foxit PDF Editor is installed and, if not, installs it silently for all users from Foxit's MSI. Activation or licensing is not part of this package. Exit code 10 means it was already installed.
symptoms: Foxit PDF Editor is not installed
I need to edit PDF files
فاکسیت ادیتور روی سیستم نصب نیست
می‌خواهم فایل PDF را ویرایش کنم

review.source: Foxit PDF Editor MSI from Foxit's enterprise downloads (package_type=msi), licensed by the organization.
review.notes: Installer not committed. Place it with scripts/set-package-files.ps1 -Id foxit-editor-install -File <path to the MSI> -Sign; it is stored as FoxitPDFEditor.msi.
